chunks: They are those on whom the sentence of God would be justified as on communities of jinns and men before them. They will surely perish.

key_terms.حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ: The sentence/decreed word became due upon them

ai.seo_question: Who are the people deserving of God's word of destruction mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar is often linked to the concept of *Haqq al-Qawl* (the inevitable decree), signifying that the punishment for these disbelievers is a just consequence of their own choices rather than arbitrary divine will. It draws a parallel between the current disbelievers and previous communities of jinns and humans, emphasizing their status as ultimate losers (*Al-Khasirun*) in the Hereafter. This reinforces the Shia understanding of divine justice, where the 'word' of God is fulfilled against those who persist in denial.
